name: DynamicFPS(AndVolume)
description: Cross-platform desktop mod to lower FPS (and volume) on unfocus.

fpsReductionPercent.name: FPS Reduction (% of your current FPS)
fpsReductionPercent.description:
<c-ff0000>***__NOTE FOR MACOS USERS: REQUIRES SDL MOD BY QIMIKO, DISABLED VSYNC, AND DISABLED FRAMERATE CAP TO APPLY.__***</c>

<mod:zmx.sdl>

Decide how much to reduce the FPS by (as a percentage of your current FPS) when the game window is unfocused.

bgVolumeReductionPercent.name: BG Volume Reduction (% of your current BG Volume)
bgVolumeReductionPercent.description: Decide how much to reduce the BG Volume by (as a percentage of your current BG Volume) when the game window is unfocused.

sfxVolumeReductionPercent.name: SFX Volume Reduction (% of your current SFX Volume)
sfxVolumeReductionPercent.description: Decide how much to reduce the SFX Volume by (as a percentage of your current SFX Volume) when the game window is unfocused.
